unlisted_practices: Reward-model evaluation of prescription-syndrome congruence for Traditional Chinese Medicine LLMs
Clinical case-based benchmark built with expert annotation for TCM syndrome differentiation and treatment

screen.reason: The study establishes and applies a benchmark dataset (TCM-BEST4SDT) to evaluate the clinical capabilities, safety, and ethics of 15 LLMs in Traditional Chinese Medicine without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
